description:
Because:

* The presentation, utils and observability splitChunks regexes had ungrouped
  alternations, so they matched lazy-only modules and pulled them into entry chunks.

This commit:

* Anchors and groups the three cacheGroups test regexes.
* Drops lodash and the unused @reach from the named groups.
* Keeps the networking group, the group names and chunks: 'all'.

Closes FXA-14855
